description: Wait in the capsule until a condition holds, instead of sleeping or taking screenshot after screenshot: present (an element matching the selector is there), absent (none is any more: a dialog closed, a spinner went away), enabled (a matching element can be used), text (an element's name or value contains text; the selector is optional), window (a window whose title contains window is open), screen_stable (nothing on screen changed for stableMs: an app or page finished drawing). Returns met (true or false), waitedMs and what matched. The wait never holds up the capsule's other calls.

exact.description: Require an exact match instead of a substring

role.description: Accessible role, e.g. 'button', 'menu item', 'text', 'terminal' (Linux AT-SPI) or 'Button', 'Edit' (Windows UI Automation)

stableMs.description: For screen_stable: how long nothing may change (default 600, at most 10000)

text.description: For text: what the name or value must contain. For present, absent and enabled: match the name OR the value

window.description: For window: a part of the title to wait for. For the element conditions: only within that window

name: capsulate_wait_for
title: Wait for a condition
